1.

Those who know their Lord In every people and land, Though seemingly without friends They stand among them; He does not forsake them, He leads them in and out, And remains their Friend From beginning to end.

2.

He knows His companies, And they know Him; In all the perils of time They look up to Him. May we never forget, What He has said to us, Treasure His word in our hearts, And give heed thereto!

3.

He shall surely lead us Through the desert’s sand, In battle and strife secure us With a mighty divine hand. We do not walk alone, For our fellowship Is with the Father and the Son, Our faithful Saviour.
